# SWING Academy

> SWING Academy is a free, bilingual (Thai/English) learning platform from the SWING Foundation, offering courses and resources on sexual health, rights, life skills, and wellbeing for sex workers and allied communities in Thailand.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SWING Academy, featured paths and courses.
- [Courses](/courses): Browse all courses by category and level.
- [Learning Paths](/paths): Four guided paths bundling ordered courses.
- [Resource Library](/resources): PDFs, videos, infographics, and links.
- [Verify a Certificate](/verify): Check a SWING Academy certificate code.

## Optional

- [Your Dashboard](/dashboard): Personal learner dashboard (sign-in required).
